description: How full the shared CI queue is, and what to do about it: level (ok / busy / saturated), runs queued and running, runner slots, estimated minutes before a new run starts, and — with owner+repo — that repository's queued/running runs, its share of CI work, the slots it may hold while others wait (per work class, and across classes), a recommendation (e.g. batch changes into fewer pushes), and `explanation`: each work class's queued/running runs (interactive, review, push, schedule) and, for each of the repository's queued runs, its class and why it waits (code + sentence, from the claim plan itself). The same `ciQueue` block the write tools return. Ask before a burst of pushes. Also `executor`: where CI runs (external runners or in-process), runners configured / reachable / busy, and `holdReason` when no runner can take a run. Read-only.

owner.description: Optional, with repo: report this repository's part of the queue

name: gluecron_ci_queue_status
